# Webhook delivery design
Send every event to the customer URL.
If a request fails, retry forever immediately.
Persist the event only after a successful response.
Guarantee exactly-once delivery without storing event IDs.
Do not define a request timeout or a response size limit.
Acceptance test: one successful delivery.

Events must survive worker crashes.
Customer endpoints can fail, be slow, or return a huge response.
Repeated deliveries must not repeat side effects.
Customer URLs are untrusted, and may resolve to internal networks.
